A leaker who previously found iPhone Duo features in Apple code has now spotted similar references for the HomePad. The setup process for the upcoming device shares common ground with the foldable iPhone.

The leaker noted that the setup process will take place within the Home app, and shared three screenshots of the setup screens……

iPhone Duo StandBy Mode

Apple's StandBy mode offers multiple options to turn your iPhone into a useful information display while charging. Leaker pdfu previously shared five unreleased iPhone Duo StandBy interfaces found in the device's Xcode simulator.

  • Home Camera
  • Home Modular
  • Flow
  • Fade
  • Snoopy

HomePad Setup Screens

One of the StandBy screen options is Photo Face, and pdfu says HomePad will also have this feature.

He explained that the setup process will prompt the device to first capture a few high-resolution photos for you to choose from immediately, while your full photo library will be downloaded from iCloud.

Apple's smart home hub is expected to launch on October 13, with a design inspired by the iMac G4. You can read more about the design here.
